rules.description: Billing resolvers must call billing-service or billing gRPC contracts, not account-service billing routes.
GraphQL billing types expose stable local IDs and provider codes only; PSP customer, card, invoice and subscription IDs stay server-side.
Gateway resolvers authenticate users through Identity token introspection before calling billing; internal service calls use RequestContext and service credentials.
Gateway Cloud gRPC clients must use explicit connection timeouts, request deadlines and correlation context before production cutover.
Removing or changing non-null GraphQL billing fields requires a major schema version.
